Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Audio Link of Conference Call  
 
This is in furtherance to our letter dated 04 August, 2026 intimating that a Conference Call 
was scheduled to be held on Friday 07 August, 2026 at 4.00 pm IST, to discuss Q1 FY27 
Earnings of the Company.

Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find below the link of audio recording of 
the aforesaid conference call duly held on the scheduled date and time:
